rows.section: Wealth tax (Valais): simple tax tariff 2026
rows.basis: Taxable net wealth on 31 December
rows.note: The simple tax is multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers on this page (and church tax for members) unless the tariff states the tax itself; ESTV Kantonsblatt, Stand Februar 2026.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Valais (Stand Februar 2026), Vermögenssteuer: Steuerberechnung
rows.label: Rate by wealth class (rate on the whole wealth)
rows.value: 1.0‰ for CHF 1,000 to 10,000, rising by class (2.5‰ at CHF 901,000 to 1,000,000) to 3.0‰ from CHF 1,901,000
